verdict.rationale: All MCP evidence describes Zoho positioning Books as an MCP *server* — external LLM agents (Claude, GPT) connect to Zoho's APIs and use Books' tools — the opposite direction from this story, which asks whether Zoho Books itself can act as an MCP client that plugs in and uses external MCP servers' tools. No evidence shows Books consuming outside MCP servers or its built-in Zia assistant connecting to third-party MCP tool providers.
